subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw add a validated host-path remapping contract for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox managed mounts, or keep identical host/container path mapping as the supported contract with better diagnostics?
rationale: The choice changes sandbox bind-source trust boundaries, operator setup compatibility, and whether future fixes need config, schema, docs, and doctor support, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define secure remapping contract
options.body: Add or sponsor validated mapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, browser, and custom bind paths, with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

options.title: Keep identical-path contract
options.body: Document and enforce that Docker Gateway deployments must mount the same host path inside the Gateway container and provide an in-product doctor warning for mismatched setups.

options.title: Land Only Narrow Skill Repair
options.body: Treat the open materialized-skills PR as a partial repair while leaving this canonical workspaceAccess issue open for the broader managed-mount contract.

recommendation.title: Define secure remapping contract
recommendation.body: Add or sponsor validated mapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, browser, and custom bind paths, with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already marked this issue as the canonical cluster and have the strongest discussion signal for the product/security choice.
